verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a REST API and an open-source Python module, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable API spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt and markdown docs index are documentation, not an API spec, and the Python module is a developer building block, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
